title: Managed Database: primary per-node reconciliation — completed primary exports
content:
## Assessment basis
Managed Database primary per-node reconciliation uses the following completed primary exports basis. Sum quantity from completed primary service-record exports for that exact source whose resource count equals the linked topology count; these archived export details support the single billed aggregate meter and are not additional billable meter postings.

## Selected-export case
Hypothetical primary per-node reconciliation records: two completed exports satisfying the stated source correlation contain quantities of 12 and 8 in the applicable usage unit. A pending export contains 40. The selected completed export total is 20; the pending quantity does not enter that total.
